craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra-adbhuta of tended glory through impurity — the Lord in wandering (v14 absent in data too: edition numbering gap, not a defect; L4 follows the L3 set). Tended means; glory proceeds; seven/36 count echoed from v09. Rejected: (a) glory→splendor → killed: glory proceeds. Read aloud: TEND-ed BY-sev-en KNOW-ers … FREE-dom's-GLO-ry pro-CEEDS.

lines: Tended by seven knowers, by thirty-six in count —
he, great Lord: freedom's glory proceeds.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pramātṛsaptakatvena ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasaṅkhyayā bhāvitaḥ | sa maheśāno mokṣalakṣmīḥ pravartate

reads_against.argmap: What tends seven and thirty-six? → Tended means, Lord tends, release-glory proceeds.
c1_essence: Tended means; Lord tends; release-glory proceeds.
God's five, self's five; delusion the difference.
Expansion sung capable; contraction called wanderer.
Withdrawn grace in oneness; manifesting named veiling.
